prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Two-Column Path Chooser Experience: Redesign the path selection screen into a two-column layout featuring distinct comparison choice cards for quick companion creation versus full customization.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Choose Companion Path", "style": "emphasis"}]}}}
1: [home, wait_info] Dynamic Render Milestone Indicator: Display a dynamic progress bar and estimated timer component on the generation waiting screen while rendering pet assets.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "label": "Generating desktop assets...", "style": "highlight"}, {"type": "timer", "label": "Estimated time remaining", "style": "small"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Pet Choice Studio: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a spotlight layout with focused preview assets and trait badges.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "preview", "style": "large"}, {"role": "pet_choices", "type": "badge", "label": "Companion Trait Preview", "style": "rounded"}]}}}
3: [home, redesign] Stage Visual Waiting Hub Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout with centered mascot animation and real-time status updates.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "replace": {"wait_status": [{"role": "wait_status", "type": "mascot", "style": "playful"}, {"role": "wait_status", "type": "text", "text": "Preparing your pet's desktop environment...", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
4: [sign_in, reorder] Adoption-First Sign-In Sequence Shift: Move sign-in after pet adoption so users personalize their pet before creating an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
5: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Background Notification Alert: Enable desktop notifications when rendering completes and display copy reassuring users they can minimize the app.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to minimize this window. We'll notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet arrives!"}}
6: [sign_in, copy] Account Preservation Sign-In Clarification: Update sign-in headline and hint to clarify that logging into an existing account restores saved pets and prevents reset issues.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Keep & Sync Your Pets", "hint": "Logging in ensures your existing pets are restored and saved safely to your account."}}
7: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Mascot Hero Redesign: Rebuild the story intro screen using a story_scroll layout featuring animated pet previews and hero introduction text.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "replace": {"intro_story": [{"role": "intro_story", "type": "animation", "style": "large"}, {"role": "intro_story", "type": "text", "text": "Meet your interactive desktop companion, ready to keep you company and assist daily.", "style": "emphasis"}]}}}
8: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Upload Clarity Helper: Add photo lighting and background requirements hint to the photo upload screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best generation results, upload a well-lit, front-facing photo with a clear subject and neutral background."}}
9: [finish, layout] Split Desktop Controls Overview: Switch home_intro to a split layout showcasing quick desktop pet interaction controls and tray visibility tips.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Your pet lives in your system tray! Click the pet to open controls or double-click to hide.", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesign maintains the job of choice path offering both options within onboarding.
Adding progress indicator and real-time wait estimate is allowed on the waiting screen.
Redesign preserves pet selection functionality on pick_friend screen.
Redesign retains waiting screen status functionality.
Reordering sign-in step after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Adding background desktop notifications to the waiting screen is permitted.
Clarifying copy on the sign-in screen is allowed and does not violate any rules.
Story scroll redesign preserves the pet introduction job of the story screen.
Adding photo upload hints is a valid onboarding enhancement.
Redesigning home_intro layout is allowed as home_intro is part of onboarding.
